business_problem: HYPE, the market-leading 100% Italian neobank with 1.9M+ users, chose MongoDB for its scale, resilience & real-time insights to support secure, agile growth.
solution_summary: HYPE, the market-leading 100% Italian neobank with 1.9M+ users, chose MongoDB for its scale, resilience & real-time insights to support secure, agile growth. Hype chose MongoDB Atlas to scale securely, boost performance, and support millions of users with real-time data and resilient architecture. Using MongoDB Atlas offers transparent pricing and powerful monitoring for Hype With over 1.9 million users, HYPE is the leading Italian fintech and a benchmark in digital money management. Nearly ten years after its launch (2015), its purpose remains unchanged: to simplify the daily management of money through an intuitive, mobile-first experience. To support its growing ecosystem, HYPE’s infrastructure chose MongoDB Atlas for its scalable cluster based pricing and powerful monitoring tools. “The fact that MongoDB is hosted in different regions is a huge guarantee both for us and for our customers,” says Mattia Rubin, Operations IT Manager at HYPE.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Online Archive
solution_components.role: Moves colder data out of the hot cluster while keeping it available for retention, analysis, and compliance.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the customer, catalog, and interaction data that powers Hype's personalized user experiences.

data_flow: Application, customer, and workflow data is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas Online Archive and MongoDB Atlas, indexed or enriched where needed, and then delivered to downstream applications, analytics, or AI features through low-latency queries and APIs. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, Azure, APIs.
business_outcome: MongoDB powers HYPE growth with zero-downtime migration, fast logins, scalable B2B ops, and a future-ready data platform.
